div.div:
Failover runbook
1 · Promote Aurora Global secondary (minutes)
2 · Add db.r7g.large instances to the cluster
3 · Terraform builds app tier from copied AMIs
4 · Bring up clinic VPNs on the standby TGW
5 · Route 53 fails the portal over
Tested: DR drill twice a year · FIS AZ tests quarterly

Recovery tiers
Tier 1 · EHR, database, interface engine
RTO 4 h · RPO ~1 min
Tier 2 · Imaging archive
RTO 24 h · RPO 15 min
Tier 3 · Reporting · best effort
AZ loss in either region: automatic, minutes
